title: TrainRenderMetadata
description: Optional render-content expectations attached to a train manifest. Consumed by tester validator test_train_renders_content.py to verify that mounting the train produces non-empty, non-stub DOM output. SPEC-CODER-TRAIN-0003.

expected_content.description: What 'rendered' means for this train. When omitted, the validator only requires textLength > 0 and stubDetected == false.

min_text_nodes.description: Minimum number of non-empty text nodes the rendered DOM must contain.

must_contain.description: Substrings or selectors that must be present in the rendered DOM.

fixture.description: Optional path to a fixture loaded into the harness before mounting (relative to repo root).

template.description: Optional layout template the train resolves through TrainView.

auth_required.description: When true, the harness mounts the train inside an authenticated session fixture.
